mapper.select:
SELECT dr.defense_id as defenseRecordId, u.name AS userName, u.user_number as userNumber, u.profile_picture AS profilePicture, dt.topic_name AS topicName, dr.score AS score, dr.status AS status, dr.report_doc_score AS reportDocScore, dr.analysis_source AS analysisSource, dr.defense_mode AS defenseMode,
CASE WHEN dr.video_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dr.video_url) != '' AND dr.video_url != 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasVideo,
CASE WHEN dr.report_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dr.report_url) != '' AND dr.report_url != 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasReport,
dr.report_url as reportUrl, dr.material_verdict AS materialVerdict, dr.material_verdict_type AS materialVerdictType, dr.material_verdict_reason AS materialVerdictReason, dr.defense_date AS defenseTime FROM defense_records dr JOIN users u ON dr.user_id = u.user_id JOIN defense_topics dt ON dr.topic_id = dt.topic_id
and u.name like concat('%',#{userName},'%') and u.user_number like concat('%',#{userNumber},'%') and dt.topic_name like concat('%',#{topicName},'%')
ORDER BY dr.defense_date DESC, dr.defense_id DESC

select dr.defense_id as defenseId, users.name as studentName, users.user_number as studentNumber, dr.defense_date as defenseTime, dr.video_url as defenseVideoUrl, dr.report_url as defenseReportUrl, dr.video_analysis as aiVideoAnalysis, dr.video_summary as aiVideoSummary, dr.report_analysis as aiReportAnalysis, dr.feedback as aiAllAnalysis, dr.report_doc_analysis as reportDocAnalysis, dr.report_doc_summary as reportDocSummary, dr.material_verdict as materialVerdict, dr.material_verdict_type as materialVerdictType, dr.material_verdict_reason as materialVerdictReason, dr.report_doc_score as reportDocScore, dr.analysis_source as analysisSource, dr.defense_mode as defenseMode,
dt.topic_name as topicName from defense_records dr join users on dr.user_id = users.user_id left join defense_topics dt on dt.topic_id = dr.topic_id where dr.defense_id = #{defenseId}

select da.answer_id as answerId, dq.question, ds.custom_question, dq.question_type as questionType, da.student_answer as studentAnswer, da.score, da.feedback, dq.standard_answer as standardAnswer, da.created_at as createdAt from defense_answers as da left join defense_questions as dq on da.question_id = dq.question_id left join defense_student_questions as ds on da.sq_id = ds.sq_id where da.defense_id = #{defenseId}
order by da.answer_id asc

select dr.defense_id as defenseRecordId, u.Name as userName, u.user_number as userNumber, u.profile_picture as profilePicture, dt.topic_name as topicName, dr.score, dr.status, dr.report_doc_score as reportDocScore, dr.analysis_source as analysisSource, dr.defense_mode as defenseMode,
CASE WHEN dr.video_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dr.video_url) != '' AND dr.video_url != 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasVideo,
CASE WHEN dr.report_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dr.report_url) != '' AND dr.report_url != 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasReport, dr.report_url as reportUrl,
dr.material_verdict AS materialVerdict, dr.material_verdict_type AS materialVerdictType, dr.material_verdict_reason AS materialVerdictReason, COALESCE(GREATEST(dr.updated_at, dr.created_at), dr.updated_at, dr.created_at) as defenseTime from defense_records dr left join users u on u.user_id = dr.user_id left join defense_topics dt on dt.topic_id = dr.topic_id where u.user_number = #{userNumber} and (dr.status = 'completed' or exists (select 1 from defense_answers da where da.defense_id = dr.defense_id)
or (dr.video_url is not null and trim(dr.video_url) != '' and dr.video_url != 'abc') or (dr.report_url is not null and trim(dr.report_url) != '' and dr.report_url != 'abc'))
order by COALESCE(GREATEST(dr.updated_at, dr.created_at), dr.updated_at, dr.created_at) desc, dr.defense_id desc
